Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to identify the correct file location for the CanFam3.1 assembly. While it correctly identified the version (CanFam3.1), it provided a link to the NCBI assembly page (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/assembly/317138) instead of the specific FTP directory link (ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/) where the actual genome files are hosted. The problem specifically asked for the "link to the files," and the Broad Institute FTP site is the primary repository for these specific assembly files, whereas NCBI serves as a database index. The agent's search and extraction logic was insufficient to distinguish between a metadata page and the actual file distribution location.
